The QuietDesk features a matte 2560x1440 panel, 75Hz refresh rate, USB-C input with 65W power delivery, and an adjustable stand for portrait use. It is intended for creative administrators and remote teams who want a calm, energy-conscious display rather than a gaming- or workstation-focused model.
